stream-analytics-v1-pricing.title: V1 Stream Analytics pricing is higher than V2
stream-analytics-v1-pricing.body: This estimate uses the older V1 (Standard or Dedicated) streaming-unit pricing. Microsoft says the V2 pricing model reduces price by up to 80% with no change to Stream Analytics capabilities, so price Standard V2 (or Dedicated V2 for a cluster) as well.

citation.quote: V2 pricing model offers price reductions of up to 80%

stream-analytics-few-jobs-vs-cluster.title: A dedicated cluster is billed hourly for as long as it exists
stream-analytics-few-jobs-vs-cluster.body: This estimate uses a dedicated cluster. Microsoft says you pay hourly for clusters on the chosen streaming-unit capacity, with no extra charge per job running in them, so the cluster costs the same whether it hosts one job or many. If the customer has only a few jobs and does not need cluster isolation or private networking, also price standard V2 jobs for comparison.

citation.quote: You pay hourly for clusters and there are no extra charges per job running in these clusters.

stream-analytics-auto-pause.title: Jobs that need not run continuously can be stopped
stream-analytics-auto-pause.body: This estimate runs the jobs all month. Microsoft describes automatically pausing Stream Analytics jobs that do not strictly need to run continuously; billing stops while a job is stopped, so price only the hours it must run if that applies.

citation.source: Auto-pause Stream Analytics jobs with PowerShell and Azure Automation
citation.quote: don't strictly need to run continuously
